neighbours.label: The operand named for a mathematical or programming operation, strongest when it is an edge-case value: 'the log of zero', 'the square root of a negative', 'on a None value'. The same words (zero, negative, None) outside an operation stay quiet.
fire: In ordinary arithmetic, the logarithm of zero is undefined.
A calculator shows an error for the square root of a negative value.
Nobody can compute the reciprocal of zero.
# taking max() of an empty list raises ValueError
The tangent of ninety degrees does not exist.
Students learn that the factorial of a negative integer is undefined.
# int() applied to a None argument fails with TypeError
The fourth root of a negative quantity is not a real number.
quiet: In ordinary winters, the temperature drops below zero at night.
A critic wrote a negative review of the new calculator.
Nobody can remember the name of the hero.
# the list is sorted before it is written to disk
The road turns ninety degrees and then climbs.
Students learn that a negative attitude spreads quickly.
# None of the arguments are logged at startup
The fourth floor of the building has a real garden.

notes: Card: ' dict' in 'push_note on a dict value', ')' in erfi(nan), ' Period' in 'Cannot apply ... to PeriodIndex', ' negative' in 'square root of a negative number', 'value set to None'.
